what: مسموح: ما أكّده المستخدم، الملكية العامة/CC0، CC BY مع الإسناد، والمخزون بإيصال؛ ممنوع: لقطات المراجع والمكشوط وND وNC التجاري. / Allowed: user-confirmed, PD/CC0, CC BY with attribution, receipted stock; banned: reference frames, scraped media, ND, NC in commercial work.
how: One ASSETS.md row per file (source, licence, author, URL). Editorial-only images never go in ads; people need model releases; AI images only when asked and declared. Faceless channels: any clip showing the speaker's face even for one frame is audio-only; sample 1 frame/s through face detection.

name_ar: تنزيل لقطة مفتوحة مع إيصال مصدر
what: ينزّل رابط HTTPS واحدًا من مضيف مسموح، يرفض صفحات التحدي، يحدّ الحجم، ويكتب إيصالًا بالبصمة والرخصة. / Downloads one explicit HTTPS URL from an allow-listed open host, refuses challenge pages, caps size and writes a hashed provenance receipt.
how: python motion.py openclip URL --out clip.mp4 [--license-note '…'] (open_footage.py). Here: commons.wikimedia.org and archive.org are reachable; pexels.com, pixabay.com and NASA images answer 403 from this container — ask the user for files instead.
params: hosts *.wikimedia.org, *.pexels.com; https only; 64 KiB–500 MiB; timeout 120 s; SHA-256 sidecar .source.json (kosif-open-footage-v1)

what: روابط بنترست وتيك توك وإنستغرام ويوتيوب وX إلى مكتبة وسائط بنسخة تحرير وملف اعتمادات. / Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X links into a media library with an edit-safe copy and a credits file.
how: python scripts/kmotion.py fetch URL… --max 30 --only video|image [--list] [--cookies]; edit copy H.264 yuv420p CFR ≤ 60 fps + AAC 48 kHz; fetch-credits.json; duplicates skipped. The test skips here because yt-dlp is not installed. Safe single-URL variant: https only, global IPs only, ≤ 150 MB, ≤ 900 s, ≤ 720p, sha256 receipt. TikTok needs an impersonation backend (curl_cffi) — otherwise ask for the file. Downloaded media keeps its source licence: reference ≠ permission.

name_ar: مجمع لقطات بأسئلة بحث ثنائية اللغة
what: كل لقطة في المرجع تُوصف بـ 1–3 عبارات بحث إنجليزية وعربية لتجمع لقطات جديدة بنفس المعنى. / Each reference shot is described by 1–3 English + Arabic searches so new footage with the same meaning lands in one pool.
how: shots[].query e.g. ['incense burner smoke aesthetic', 'bakhoor mabkhara']; 2–3 candidates per shot, clip ≥ shot length (or ≥ 0.67× when slowed), ≥ 720p, no watermark or burned text; credit every pin. When the host is unreachable publish an intermediary page with key frames and search buttons for the user to fetch.

what: رفع بالسحب والإفلات، كل ملف يُفحص (مدة، فيديو، صوت) ويُصنف. / Drag-and-drop upload, every file probed (duration, video, audio) and classified.
how: POST /api/media (multipart, 1 MB chunks), GET/DELETE /api/media/NAME; index in workbench/media/.index.json. Accepts mp4 mov mkv webm avi m4v mp3 wav m4a aac flac ogg png jpg webp gif json txt srt; ≤ 4 GB per file.

what: رتّب كل اللقطات على زمن التصوير مع تصحيح فرق ساعة كل كاميرا. / Sort every clip on recorded time, correcting each camera's clock offset.
how: Read creation_time via ffprobe (or exiftool); measure one offset per camera from a pair of clips of the same moment (--offset prefix=seconds); timeline fps = the most common clip fps; dry-run table: file, time, camera, resolution, fps, gamma.

what: جدول تسجيل في آخر الستوري بورد وإعدادات موحدة لكل اللقطات. / A recording table at the end of the storyboard and one set of capture settings.
how: Native resolution (e.g. 3840×2160), 30 fps matching the timeline, per-window capture, enlarged cursor, mic and system audio on separate tracks, H.264/H.265 CQP 18–20, editor font ≥ 16 pt (terminal 18), notifications off, history cleared.

what: يكشف القطعات بـ scdet، يرسم لوحة لقطات، يقسّم، ويكتب مواصفة تايملاين بانتقالات. / Detects cuts with scdet, draws a contact sheet, splits, and writes a timeline spec with transitions.
how: python scripts/kmotion.py scenes CLIP.mp4 --sheet shots.png --timeline edit.json [--split DIR --transition fade]; API scenes.detect(clip, threshold=10, min_len=.5). Ran here: tests.test_v6 ScenesTests ok (3 shots found at 2.0 s and 4.0 s ±0.15). Robust variant in decaption.analyse: 90×160 grey diff, threshold max(12, 6×median), > 4× local median over ±15 frames, cuts ≥ 5 frames apart (codecs that smear a cut over two frames).

what: عيّنات عبر المدة كلها في لوحة واحدة، ثم اختيار إطار غلاف يشرح الفيديو بنظرة. / Samples across the whole duration on one sheet, then a cover frame that explains the video at a glance.
how: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=320:-1,tile=3x2" -frames:v 1 sheet.png, or select='gt(scene,0.3)' for change-driven sheets. Skip transition, blurred, first and last frames; shortlist distinct candidates with timestamps; for composed films render the chosen moment straight from the composition at each target size; animated covers loop with a ~0.4 s crossfade; check at phone size. تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16).

what: لكل خانة إيقاع تُختار أنشط نافذة غير مستخدمة من اللقطة التالية حسب طاقة فرق الإطارات. / For each beat slot the most active unused window of the next clip is chosen by frame-difference energy.
how: montage.energy(clip, fps=6) + montage.pick(…); rank segments by measured motion, never guess. Basma's probe samples every clamp(D/30, 0.5, 2) s for motion, sharpness and brightness and treats motion > 45 as an internal cut.

what: مقاطع الهاتف تبدأ بثانية بيضاء أو غير مركزة؛ واللقطات المتقاربة المتشابهة مكررة. / Phone clips start with ~1 s of white or soft frames; near-identical takes are duplicates.
how: Compare the first 2 s with a 2–5 s reference window: trim until mean luma is within ±20% and focus (Laplacian variance, cv2 is installed here) recovers; skip clips < 5 s; gimbal cameras need no trim. Duplicates: shot within 2 min and middle-frame luma histograms correlate ≥ 0.9 → keep the sharpest after the user confirms. Large pools: perceptual hash (dHash) with PIL + numpy.

name_en: Image exposure analysis + Arabic fix advice
what: يقيس نسب الإضاءة والمدى والقص والظلال المسحوقة ويحكم على التعريض، ثم يقترح الإصلاح بالعربية. / Measures luma percentiles, range, clipping and crushed shadows, gives an exposure verdict and Arabic fix advice.
how: python3 scripts/omni/image_analyze.py IMAGE [--summary]; EXIF-transposed, ≤ 1600 px, Rec.709 luma. Advice triggers: clipped > 2%, crushed > 10%, range < 120, soft, noisy, colour cast, subject off the thirds grid.
params: clip ≥ 250; crushed ≤ 5; over if mean > 185 or clipped > 5%; under if mean < 60 or crushed > 15%

what: يقيس كل حد قطع أو ذوبان أو تعتيم أو انزلاق بالإطار، وأطوال اللقطات، والمظهر، ومنطقة النص، والصوت. / Measures every cut/dissolve/dip/slide boundary to the frame, shot lengths, look, text zone, fades, flashes and audio.
how: python scripts/kmotion.py mimic study REF.mp4 --out PROJECT/study → shots.jpg, strip.jpg (frame/0.5 s), text/shot_XX.png, mimic.json. Then mimic layer DIR --erase x0,y0,x1,y1 lifts the fixed design layer as overlay.png (creator handles erased, badges snapped by HSV). Ran here: tests.test_mimic all ok (frame-exact cuts, dissolve place/length, dip, exposure fades inside a shot not counted as cuts). Measure the reference — never copy its media.

what: نبضات ≤ 3 ث مع لوحة ألوان لكل نبضة وطاقة الحركة والتحريك والانتقال المتوقع والجهارة والإيقاع. / Beats ≤ 3 s with a per-beat hex palette, motion energy, pan, likely transition, loudness, tempo and onsets.
how: kmotion analyze VIDEO --max-beat 3.0 [--transcribe] [--batch DIR]. For a scene-by-scene recreation schema sample ~12 evenly spaced frames ≤ 1024 px and describe shot type, camera motion, lighting and mood per scene, with scene N's end frame = scene N+1's start.

what: رفع الدقة يعيد الحجم والحدة لا المعلومة المفقودة. / Upscaling restores size and sharpness, not missing information.
how: Jagged edges from low resolution → upscale; uniform focus blur → no; JPEG blocks or ISO noise → partial; pixelated logo → fetch the SVG. Save as name_upN.png, never overwrite the source. Modest scaling with ffmpeg scale flags=lanczos; AI upscalers (Real-ESRGAN, Topaz) need install or keys and run once on the final concat, not per segment. Source rule: long side ≥ 1.5× displayed size at max scale (1080×1920 at 1.12 → ~2400 px).

what: مواصفة JSON للمقاطع والصور وبطاقات اللون مع قص وزوم وتلوين ومنحدرات سرعة وانتقالات وطبقات نص وترجمة تُرندر في أمر FFmpeg واحد مع بوابة جودة. / A JSON spec of clips, stills and colour cards with in/out, zoom, grade, speed ramps, transitions and text/caption overlays compiles into one FFmpeg render with a QA gate.
how: kmotion timeline --example edit.json, then timeline.build(spec, out, workers, inspect) → report {seconds, transitions, audio, gate{lufs}}. Ramps [[t, speed]…] → setpts with log(); atempo chain (0.25 → atempo=0.5,atempo=0.5); ratio '1:1' → 1080×1080; overlays: text anim 'rise' with box #00000080, lower-third, logo upper-right ×.5, progress #E7B65A 4 px, captions style 'tiktok'; music ducked under clip audio at −14 LUFS. Ran here: test_v6 TimelineTests (build_film, validation, text_png) and RampTests ok.
params: example: 9:16, 30 fps, bg #0d1b2a; clip zoom 1.0→1.08 grade teal_orange, circleopen 0.6 s; ramp [[0,1],[2,.3],[4,1]]

what: اقطع من أي إطار بإعادة الترميز؛ القص بلا ترميز يعمل فقط على الإطارات المفتاحية. / Cut at any frame by re-encoding; stream-copy cuts only work on keyframes.
how: python tools.py trim CLIP --from 3.2 --to 9.8 --out part.mp4 (crf 18 yuv420p, AAC 192k 48 kHz). Raw: ffmpeg -ss T -i in -to D -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 192k -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart. -c copy only when the in-point is an I-frame, otherwise 2–5 s of frozen picture; inside compositions prefer non-destructive trim props (data-media-start, trimBefore).

name_ar: دمج مقاطع مختلفة دون كسر الصوت
what: يدمج المقاطع بالترتيب ويلائم كل واحد في مقاس واحد ويملأ المقاطع الصامتة بصمت. / Joins clips in order, fitting each to one size and filling silent clips with silence so audio never breaks.
how: python tools.py concat A.mp4 B.mp4 --out all.mp4 [--size 1080x1920 --fps 30] (pad black, anullsrc 48 kHz stereo). Same-codec clips: concat demuxer (-f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy). Mixed: per input fps=30,scale=W:H:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=W:H,setsar=1 then concat=n=N:v=1:a=1.

what: سرعة متغيرة على اللقطة مع الحفاظ على طبقة الصوت، أو سرعة ثابتة بطيئة. / Variable speed along a clip with pitch-preserved audio, or a constant slow rate.
how: Timeline ramp [[t, speed]…] (RampTests ok here) maps time with setpts and chains atempo (each factor 0.5–2). Quick check here: setpts='if(lt(T,1),PTS,PTS*2)' runs. HyperFrames: data-playback-rate 0.1–10 (consumed source = timeline × rate) or a 'rate' lane in data-automation; later starts shift by old/rate. Slow-mo below 0.5× from 30 fps footage stutters — ask for 60/120 fps sources.

what: يحذف الوقفات صورةً وصوتًا في مرور واحد. / Removes pauses from picture and sound in one pass.
how: python scripts/kmotion.py silence CLIP.mp4 --out cut.mp4 --threshold -35 --min 0.45 --pad 0.08. Transcript-driven alternative (HyperFrames transcript-cut.mjs): remove ranges, filler words and silences ≥ 0.8 s from word timestamps. Keep 80 ms pads so words never clip.

what: امسك لحظة بصورة ثابتة لمدة محددة، أو كرر مقطعًا بذيل يذوب في رأسه. / Hold a moment as a still for N seconds, or loop a clip with its tail dissolving into its head.
how: Freeze: extract the frame (ffmpeg -ss T -frames:v 1) and place it as an clip (data-start, data-duration), deciding audio continue/trim/silence explicitly. Loop: kmotion loop --seconds 30. Dress the freeze with paper/tape/flash (HyperFrames freeze-frame-dressing, 4 s).

what: محرر محلي بلا رفع: استيراد، مشاهد على تايملاين، طبقات نص وأشكال، صوت، تراجع، حفظ، ومعاينة حية. / A local upload-free editor: import, scenes on a timeline, text/shape layers, soundtrack, undo, save/open, live preview.
how: Serve the site and open /studio/. Limits: 60 s project, 24 clips, 24 overlays, 48 assets, 200 MB per file, canvas 1280×720 / 720×1280 / 720×720. Projects import into the FFmpeg timeline: POST /api/studio/import → studio_import.convert() (StudioImportTests ok here).

name_ar: مونتاج مستقل أو متتابع في Remotion
name_en: Remotion clip editing: independent vs ripple
what: نموذجان: مقاطع بمواضع مطلقة (فراغات وتداخل مسموح) أو تسلسل متتابع يزيح ما بعده. / Two models: absolutely placed clips (gaps/overlaps allowed) or ripple sequences where one change shifts all later clips.
how: Independent: each <Video> with from/trimBefore/durationInFrames. Ripple: <TransitionSeries> of <TransitionSeries.Sequence durationInFrames> wrapping <Video trimBefore>. Remotion bundles ffmpeg via npx remotion ffmpeg/ffprobe.
license: Remotion برخصة الشركة؛ @remotion/transitions غير مرخصة MIT / Remotion company license; @remotion/transitions is UNLICENSED on npm.

what: تثبيت بمرورين عبر vidstab أو deshake عند غيابه — فقط عندما يكون الاهتزاز مقاسًا. / Two-pass vidstab stabilisation (deshake fallback) — only when shake is measured.
how: python tools.py stabilize CLIP --out steady.mp4 [--strength 10]: vidstabdetect shakiness=min(10,s) accuracy=15 → vidstabtransform smoothing=2 s optzoom=1 + unsharp 5:5:0.5; fallback deshake rx=ry=32. Ran here on a test clip: method 'vidstab (2-pass)', duration preserved. Prefer similarity mode and keep crop ≤ 10%; if edges bend, lower strength.

what: نظّف ضوضاء الإضاءة المنخفضة واستعد حدة الحواف، ثم سوداء أنظف وانحناء إضاءات ودرجات وسطى أدفأ. / Clean low-light noise and restore edges, then cleaner blacks, highlight roll-off and warmer mids.
how: Fast: hqdn3d=4:3:6:4.5,unsharp=5:5:0.6; better/slower: nlmeans=s=3..5; archival chroma: chromanr. Reel chain: hqdn3d=1.2:1.2:3:3, Lanczos reframe, eq=contrast=1.12:brightness=-0.015:saturation=1.07:gamma=0.97, curves, colorbalance, cas=0.3. تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16).

what: يجد حبر الترجمة الأبيض أو الأصفر بحد أسود، ويعيد بناء اللقطات الثابتة من وسيط البكسل ويرمم المتحركة. / Finds white/yellow caption ink next to a black outline; rebuilds locked-off shots from the per-pixel median and inpaints moving shots.
how: python decaption.py VIDEO --out CLEAN.mp4 [--band 0.45:0.56] [--keep-credit] [--report]. Ran here: test_decaption_erases_a_burned_caption ok.
params: white V>205 S<55; yellow H 16–38 S>110 V>150; dark outline V<70 within 9 px; masks ±3 frames; Telea inpaint r 9; output crf 12

what: وجوه أو مناطق تُبكسل أو تُموه أو تُغطى في كل إطار مع تتبع وهامش واستمرار عند ضياع الكشف، والصوت كما هو. / Faces or regions pixelated, blurred or boxed every frame with tracking, margin and hold through misses; audio untouched.
how: python scripts/kmotion.py privacy CLIP.mp4 --out safe.mp4 --mode pixelate|blur|box [--strength 18 --pad 0.25 --every 2 --hold 0.6] [--region x,y,w,h[,from,to]]. Detectors YuNet > Haar > skin. Here cv2 5.0 is present but has no Haar data, the YuNet ONNX is not shipped, and the skin fallback needs scipy — the test errors on that import. Manual regions work. Rules: faces ≥ 40 px tall at 4K are identifiable; one soft window over the whole path (softness ≥ 30%); mosaic block ≈ face height/4. ffmpeg crop→pixelize→overlay is verified here.
install: pip install scipy  # or put face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx in scripts/kit/models/

what: أزل خلفية خضراء أو زرقاء أو سادة وركّب المتحدث فوق لقطات أو رسوم جديدة. / Remove a green, blue or plain backdrop and composite the speaker over new footage or graphics.
how: [fg]chromakey=0x00FF00:similarity=0.10..0.18:blend=0.05..0.1,despill=type=green[k];[bg][k]overlay (YUV sources chromakey, RGB colorkey). تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16). Browser variant (Basma chromaMask): YCbCr chroma distance with a luma term, smoothstep soft edge between 0.55·tol and tol, mask blur W/360; auto key from four 8×8 corner patches.

name_ar: تعديل الصورة: إعادة تلوين تحفظ الظلال
what: «غيّر الذهبي إلى الأزرق» يُفهم محليًا بلا ذكاء اصطناعي، ويعيد التلوين مع حفظ الطيات والظلال. / 'Change the gold to blue' is parsed locally without AI and recoloured while keeping folds and shadows.
how: python edit_pack.py photo.jpg 'make the shirt red'; recolor(img, src_hex, dst_hex, tolerance=40, region, keep_shading=True) scales HSV saturation/value; also adjust, tint, paint, write, erase (blur-fill), flip. 18 Arabic colour names (ذهبي #d4a53a، كحلي #1f2d6b، عنابي #7b1e2b …). The original is kept as a <<KOSIF:ORIGINAL:sha>> key so any AI edits a program, not the bytes. Ran here: local-edit and colour-request tests ok.

what: قص ملء، إزالة الأبيض إلى شفافية، تقليم، تحويل وتدفئة قبل التحريك. / Fill-crop, white-to-alpha, trim, convert and warm grade before animating.
how: Here the binary is 'convert' (ImageMagick 6), not 'magick'. Fill-crop: -resize WxH^ -gravity center -extent WxH; white→alpha: -fuzz 10% -transparent white, then -channel A -blur 0x1 -level 50%,100%; -trim +repage; WebP -quality 85; warm -modulate 100,110,105; -contrast-stretch 2%x1%. Single-colour logo backdrop alternative (Basma removeImgBG): corner colours must agree (spread ≤ 70), edge flood fill, anti-aliased alpha.

what: يخرج قصاصة شفافة للمتحدث (webm/mov/png ألفا) مع لوح خلفي معكوس اختياري. / Produces a transparent cut-out of the presenter (webm/mov/png alpha) with an optional inverse plate.
how: npx hyperframes remove-background presenter.mp4 -o presenter.webm [--background-output plate.mp4] [--quality fast|balanced|best (crf 30/18/12)] [--device auto|cpu]; u2net human seg at 320×320, ~9 fps on CoreML (slower on CPU here). Alternatives: pip install rembg (stills/frames), MediaPipe selfie segmentation in the browser (CDN), Transformers.js image-segmentation / depth-estimation in Node (models from Hugging Face, reachable).
license: HyperFrames Apache-2.0؛ مكتبة u2net وأوزانها تُنزَّل عند أول تشغيل / HyperFrames is Apache-2.0; u2net weights download on first run.

what: عنوان كبير يظهر خلف جسد المتحدث ووجهه واضح. / A large title appears behind the speaker's body while the face stays clear.
how: Three layers in lockstep with the same data-start: z1 full mp4 base, z2 headline, z3 alpha webm cut-out. Timing 0–1 s shot, 1–2 s title reveal, 2–5 s hold. Check hair and hands; never cover eyes or mouth. Photo version: title sandwiched between background and cut-out subject (≤ 3 layers).

what: المتحدث مقصوص بحد أبيض فوق خلفية مختلفة لكل جملة. / The speaker, cut out with a white outline, sits over a different backdrop per sentence.
how: Matte per frame (FOOT-31), add a 6–8 px white outline and a 20 px soft shadow, swap the backdrop on sentence boundaries from words.json.

what: نقطة وخط قصير مثبتان على جزء متحرك، أو دائرة رفيعة تلاحق تفصيلة صغيرة أثناء الشرح. / A dot and short leader stay pinned to a moving part, or a thin ring follows a small detail during the explanation.
how: Track to a null with an OpenCV point tracker (cv2 5.0 is importable here) or manual keys every few frames + interpolation; draw the overlay in HTML at the tracked coordinates. Hide the label when the target is occluded or leaves frame; never cover the evidence. Timing: 0–1 intro, 1–2 line appears, 2–6 track.

what: ملصق يتبع منظور حائط والكاميرا تتحرك، أو بطاقة في يد تصبح رسمًا يتبع ميلها والأصابع فوقها. / A sticker follows a wall's perspective as the camera moves, or a card held in a hand becomes a diagram following its tilt with fingers on top.
how: Four-corner keyframes (manual or an OpenCV homography) → CSS matrix3d per frame, or ffmpeg perspective=x0:y0:x1:y1:x2:y2:x3:y3 (تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16).). Add matching grain and blur; finger masks + their shadow stay on top. No fake certificates or ads.

name_en: Freeze the subject, keep the world moving
what: المؤدي يتجمد داخل الإطار والخلفية القصيرة تستمر. / The performer freezes while a short background keeps moving.
how: 0–1 s motion, 1–3 s subject frozen, 3–4 s return: frozen frame of the person + matte overlaid on the running plate; a clean plate where the original body ghosts through. Chronophotography variant: 3 frozen, spaced poses with an opacity/colour gradient, then motion resumes — copies are time markers, not extra people.

what: صورة ثابتة فيها منطقة واحدة حية (بخار فوق فنجان) بدورة تقسم المدة فتتكرر بلا قفزة. / A still with one feathered living region (steam over a cup) whose period divides the duration so it loops seamlessly.
how: Driven only by seek time; period divides the clip length. HyperFrames block cinemagraph (10 s, swap the placeholder for your still + masked looping video).
license: HyperFrames Apache-2.0؛ مكتبة u2net وأوزانها تُنزَّل عند أول تشغيل / HyperFrames is Apache-2.0; u2net weights download on first run.

what: خط فاصل يتحرك بين الأصل والنتيجة بنفس الكادر. / A divider moves between original and result in the same framing.
how: 0–1 s define both, 1–4 s divider moves, 4–6 s stop; linear mask + 2 px divider + date/condition label. Never change light or lens between the sides. Local: HTML clip-path inset, or ffmpeg overlay with an animated crop. Matte-vs-composite split (key pass left, final right) is a strong compositing reveal.
params: 6 s; divider 2 px; wipe 600 ms–1.2 s

what: دفع أو تحريك بسرعة ثابتة، حركات متناوبة، بلا توقفات منحنية، والتحريك من اليمين للعربية. / Constant-velocity push or pan, alternating moves, no eased stops; pans run right-to-left for Arabic.
how: 1.00→1.06 over 4–6 s (1–1.5%/s), ceiling 1.12, pan < 6% of width; linear or cubic-bezier(0.37,0,0.63,1) before a cut. ffmpeg: zoompan=z='min(1+0.0004*on,1.06)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d=150:s=1080x1920:fps=30 (تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16). — feed a source ≥ 1.5× the output to avoid zoompan jitter). Documentary hold: push 1.055 + pan 4% over 4.5 s, lower third enters 600–1100 ms.

what: إزاحة كل طبقة = إزاحة الكاميرا × معامل عمقها، مع حركة مقصودة وانجراف دائم بجيبين. / Layer offset = camera offset × depth factor, plus an intentional move and a perpetual two-sine drift.
how: x = 6·sin(2πt/7) + 4·sin(2πt/11), y periods 9 s / 13 s; one camera function (pan + drift + linear zoom) × depth in both Remotion and the Canvas seek version (ParallaxPhoto, 1080×1920, 5 s). Skip parallax when the long side < 1600 px or the subject can't be separated. Oversize each layer by 2× max travel + 4% and put a 1.3× copy blurred 24 px behind to hide edges; depth blur ~1 px per 100 px of distance (bg 3, mid 1), never on the subject.
params: bg 0.15 · mid 0.45 · subject 1.0 · occluder 1.4; zoom ≤ 1.10; drift ≤ 12 px; pans 30–60 px/s

name_ar: كشف بارالاكس ثلاثي ومن الكولاج إلى البطل
what: طبقات تظهر، الشخص يقفز، تحريك 40 بكسل، والعنوان ينزلق بين الخلفية والشخص؛ أو شبكة صور تنهار إلى صورة بطل. / Layers fade, the subject pops, a 40 px pan, the title slides between background and subject; or a photo grid collapses to one hero.
how: Reveal: bg scale 1.15, mid 1.06; subject 200–800 ms spring 14/120; pan 400–2600 ms; title 900–1400 ms; push 1.5%/s. Collage: 2×3 grid enters from the top-right (RTL) with 60 ms stagger over 400 ms, drifts 20 px, exits 250 ms with 40 ms stagger, hero pushes 1.06.

what: النص فوق صورة مزدحمة يجلس على تدرج لا مربع أسود، ويُتحقق من التباين إطارًا بإطار. / Text over a busy picture sits on a gradient scrim, not a black box, and contrast is checked per frame.
how: Gradient 0.6→0 over 35% of frame height, contrast ≥ 4.5:1, text ≥ 36 px; or a 40–60% black scrim, a solid pill, or stroke/shadow. Verify luminance in the caption band with ffmpeg signalstats YAVG per frame (تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16).). Dark product plates: navy multiply overlay 40–55% + vignette so oversized type reads.

name_en: Archive photo opens onto the present
what: إطار صورة قديمة يتمدد حتى يطابق المكان نفسه في لقطة حديثة ثم يذوب. / An old print's frame expands to match the same place in modern footage, then dissolves.
how: 0–2 s photo, 2–5 s match (perspective corner pin + scale), 5–8 s modern scene with a tuned dissolve; show the photo date; never imply a false location match; sound moves from old to modern ambience. Documentary style: warm dark #15130F, ivory #EFE6D8, red #C0392B; Amiri 700 + IBM Plex Sans Arabic 500; Ken Burns 1.0→1.08 over 6 s.

what: الكشف من اليمين، الشبكات من أعلى اليمين، الشخص يسار والنص يمين، ولا تعكس صورة فيها كتابة أو علم أو شعار. / Reveals RTL, grids from top-right, subject left and text right; never mirror photos with writing, flags, logos or steering wheels.
how: Margins 5% / 12%; pills inherit their layer's transform; fixed depth order background → mid → cut-out subject → graphics.

what: بارالاكس 2D، مونتاج مختلط فيروسي، ومونتاج تحريري — جاهزة للبناء. / 2D parallax, viral mixed media and editorial montage — ready to scaffold.
how: python3 tools/kosif.py scaffold parallax-2d|viral-mixed-media|editorial <dir>; list --category photos (34 entries). Viral mixed media: beat-cut every 1–2 s, cut-outs with contact shadow, ≤ 7 words of kinetic type, grain 2–4%. Editorial: photo rig + type grid, masks and wipes 350–500 ms, one grade, grain, vignette 10–15%.

what: الصورة نفسها في أعمدة بفلتر مختلف لكل عمود، أو جدار مربعات 9:16 تنجرف ببطء. / The same photo in N columns, each with its own filter; or a wall of 9:16 tiles drifting slowly.
how: Columns reveal with 80 ms stagger and labels below; tile wall at varied offsets drifting 10–40 px/s; collage flash variant: scanned detail crops hard-cut every 300 ms with a click per hit.

what: يعيد ترميز المقطع بحيث كل إطار مفتاحي، فيُبحث <video> داخل التكوين بدقة الإطار، ويطبع الوسم الجاهز. / Re-encodes a clip so every frame is a keyframe, letting a <video> inside a composition seek frame-exactly; prints the tag to paste.
how: python motion.py footage CLIP --out projects/X/assets/clip.mp4 [--from 0 --dur 5 --width 1280 --fps 30] (libx264 -g 1 crf 16, Lanczos, muted, yuv420p, +faststart). In the page: <video data-start data-duration muted>; the motion-kit shim seeks currentTime = t − start, hides it outside its span and waits for 'seeked' (0.5 ms tolerance). Ran here: a 3 s test clip came out with all 90 frames as keyframes and the ready tag.

name_ar: عرض الأفقي في 9:16 فوق نسخة مموهة
name_en: Landscape in 9:16 over a blurred fill
what: الإطار الأفقي كاملًا فوق نسخة مكبرة مموهة بدل قص الوسط الذي يخفي الحدث. / The whole landscape frame over a blurred enlarged copy instead of a centre crop that hides the action.
how: split → scale+crop to 1080×1920 + boxblur=40:2 → overlay the 1080-wide foreground centred (تحققتُ منه في هذه الحاوية (ffmpeg 6.1.1، 2026-10-16) / verified in this container (ffmpeg 6.1.1, 2026-10-16).). The montage tool picks this chain automatically (_fit_chain, MixedMontage test ok here). Screenshots never appear raw: rounded 12–16 px corners, shadow and a designed background or device frame.

what: مقطع الكلام العمودي هو اللوح، والرسوم والضوء والجسيمات والترجمة طبقات HTML فوقه، وكاميرا افتراضية تحركه. / The vertical talking clip is the plate; graphics, light, particles and captions are HTML layers above it, with a virtual camera moving the plate.
how: + layers (#bloom, #rays, #scrim 52%→.74, #vig, #dim, #particles) + SVG + type; prepare the plate with FOOT-47. Opening: plate starts saturate(.55) brightness(.92) and blooms to full colour in 0.6 s power3.out as the hook word lands, dim overlay 0.42→0 in 0.55 s. Under kinetic type: alternate push 1.04→1.10 / 1.10→1.04 per shot (smoothstep), kick +1.8%, payoff brightness +22%.

what: يحوّل مواصفة تحرير فوق لقطة متحدث إلى تايملاين واحد: دفع بطيء لكل لقطة، ضربات كلمات مفتاحية، ثلاثة مستويات نص، فصول، ونهاية مقصودة. / Turns an edit spec over a talking-head plate into one timeline: slow push per shot, keyword punches, three text levels, chapters and a deliberate end.
how: kmotion direct CLIP → edit.js (window.EDIT: shots, punches, captions, keys, motifs, chapters, payoff, credit, palette) → directed.html builds the GSAP timeline; sizes designed at 1080 px wide.
params: punch expo.out 0.14 s then −60% over 0.6 s; hook dim .38→0 in .55 s; ivory #F5F0E6; accent #E7B65A
license: GSAP مدمج برخصة GSAP القياسية — ليست MIT / vendored GSAP under its standard license (not MIT).

what: مقابلة أو بودكاست كما هو، مع بطاقات متزامنة مع النص: عناوين، أسماء، أرقام، اقتباسات، لوحات جانبية، صورة داخل صورة. / An interview/podcast untouched, wrapped in transcript-synced cards: titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, pull-quotes, side panels, PiP.
how: ffprobe + audio → hyperframes transcribe → corrected transcript → storyboard.json (schemaVersion 3; layout, themeId, seed; cards[zone, startSec]) → per-card HTML → one paused master timeline → render. Footage stays untouched; the wrapper tweens between layouts.

what: لقطات مكتومة في إطار مستدير وحركات Lottie متجهة داخل التايملاين، تُبحث من الساعة الرئيسية. / Muted footage in a rounded frame and Lottie vector animations inside the timeline, sought from the master clock.
how: Seek video.currentTime and lottie goToAndStop(frame) from t (autoplay false). Frame example 680×840 r16; Lottie pop 0.3→1 in 0.35 s back.out(1.6). Backdrops (Basma drawBG): cover fit, blur, 5% breathing zoom on stills, dim 0–0.8.

what: طبقة فيلم كامل الشاشة تختار 4K أو 720p حسب الشاشة والشبكة، ولا تحجب الشاشة الحقيقية أبدًا. / A full-screen film overlay that picks 4K or 720p by viewport and network and never blocks the real entry screen.
how: 4K only if width ≥ 1100 px, effectiveType not 2g/3g and no saveData; on error retry 720p once; poster fallback; failsafe close 14 s; close 950 ms after 'ended'; skip when seen this session, deep link, reduced motion, saveData or deviceMemory ≤ 2; muted autoplay + sound toggle; focus trap; Escape skips. Ran here: node tools/brand_art.test.mjs → pass 5, fail 0.
params: breakpoint 1100 px; failsafe 14 s; end hold 950 ms

what: إيقاعات، أفضل النوافذ، دفع للصور، الأفقي فوق نسخة مموهة، −14 LUFS، واعتمادات. / Beats, best windows, photo pushes, landscape over a blurred copy, −14 LUFS and credits.
how: kmotion montage MEDIA --music track --ratio 9:16 [--grade] [--voice] [--captions]; montage.cut([dir], music, out, ratio='9:16', punch=False). Ran here: MixedMontage folder-photos-and-fit test ok. Grammar: quick ~1 s and breathing ~3 s shots, breathing shots end on downbeats, zoom punches on downbeats (2× supersampled), grades teal_orange, golden_hour, cyberpunk, vintage_film, matrix_tech, clean_commercial, magma_night, blue_hour, sodium_night; sidechain ducking; −14 LUFS / −1 dBTP.

name_ar: ريل من مقطع كلام بأمر واحد
what: مقطع كلام خام ← ريل عمودي: تفريغ ومسح ترجمة بالتوازي، ترميم وتأطير، سلسلة صوت، موسيقى عند الحاجة، كاريوكي واعتماد، −14 LUFS وبوابة تسليم. / Raw talking clip → finished vertical short: transcribe + decaption in parallel, restore + reframe, voice chain, music only if none, karaoke + credit, −14 LUFS, delivery gate.
how: python reel.py CLIP.mp4 --out FINAL.mp4 [--size 1080x1920 --model large-v3|small --music auto|none|bed.wav --style reels|tiktok|hormozi|boxed|minimal|cinema|punchy --credit '…' --transcript words.json]. Owner's recorded run IMG_9262: gate ok, −14.5 LUFS, TP −2.7, caption band 598–706. Needs faster-whisper for transcription (see SYNC).

what: يقطع 1–8 ريلز من محاضرة طويلة: خطّاف إلى خلاصة ينتهي بجملة كاملة، ثم ترجمة وعنوان وكاميرا متحدث وصوت منظف. / Cuts 1–8 vertical reels from a long talk: self-contained hook-to-payoff highlights ending on full sentences, then captions, a hook title, talking-head camera and cleaned speech.
how: REELS.find({count, length}): count 5 (> 600 s), 3 (> 180 s) else 2, max 8; length 15–75 s (default 40); an AI picks from a timed transcript (≤ 24,000 chars). Local fallback REELS.local scores windows by words/second snapped to sentences (break on . ! ؟ ? … or > 9 s) — usable without a key. Shorts handles: 60 s + 2×15 s pre/post needs 90 s of source.

what: صوت أو فيديو ← تفريغ بالكلمة ← سيناريو ومشاهد ← لقطات مطابقة ← قطع على الكلمات ← ترجمة ← مراجعة ← رندر. / Audio/video → word-level transcript → scenario and scenes → matching footage → cuts on the words → captions → review → render.
how: window.BasmaAutoEdit.run (9:16, pace med, 2 caption words); sources Openverse/Wikimedia (+ Pexels/Pixabay with keys — blocked from this container), motion-graphics inserts, SFX, VFX plan (grade, particles, grain, leak, vignette, letterbox, ≤ 4 crash-zoom accents). Needs the Basma app and its AI keys. Rule: cover silences and abstract explanation with real footage, one mood and one light across the pool.

what: حتى 24 لقطة وصورة: يدرس كل لقطة، يرتبها الذكاء من لوحة مرقمة، ويقطع على الإيقاع مع حركات كاميرا وانتقالات ومؤثرات. / Up to 24 clips/photos: probes each, an AI orders them from a numbered contact sheet, cuts on the beat with camera moves, transitions and SFX.
how: MON.run: probe in parallel batches of 3; 4-column numbered sheet; AI decides order, hook title, 0–6 lines, pace and grade; lengths snapped to beats within 0.4 s; bestWindow picks lively, sharp, well-lit windows away from cuts. Pro variant (PROMONT) adds template motion inserts.

name_ar: إعادة مونتاج اللقطات من قائمة قطع محدودة
name_en: Bounded EDL recut: trim/concat with denoise and loudnorm
what: يأخذ فيديو أصليًا وقائمة نطاقات --cut START:END فيقصّها ويرتبها ويعيد قياسها إلى مقاس الهدف مع صوتها، ويترك الأصل كما هو. / Takes a source and explicit --cut ranges, trims, concatenates and reframes them with their audio, leaving the original untouched.
how: ffprobe first; each range must be finite, 0 ≤ a < b ≤ duration+0.03 and ≥ 0.10 s; at most 30 cuts; refuses output == input. Per cut: trim + setpts, scale=W:H:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease, pad centred, fps, setsar=1, yuv420p; audio atrim + asetpts + aresample=48000 (+ afftdn=nf=-25 with --denoise); concat=n:v=1:a=1; --normalize appends loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11. No-audio sources get -an. Prints a JSON receipt (duration, streams, cuts, denoised). Re-ran here on the bundled 4 s test clip with --cut 0:1.2 --cut 2:3.4 --denoise --normalize → 2.625 s, h264 480×854 24 fps + AAC. Note: loudnorm here targets −16 LUFS; the superpowers delivery target is −14 LUFS, so pass the final mix through your own loudnorm step.
params: ≤30 cuts · ≥0.1 s each · afftdn nf=-25 · loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=11 · crf 21 · default 480×854@24

what: المادة الأصلية هي الأساس: احفظ مدتها وترتيبها وكلامها ووقفاتها ونسبتها وصوتها، وابنِ خريطة زمن من المصدر إلى البرنامج قبل أي إضافة. — The source is the base: keep its duration, order, speech, pauses, aspect and sound, and build a source-to-programme time map before adding anything.
when: مونتاج متحدث أو مقابلة أو فيديو أرسله المستخدم — editing a talking head, interview or user video.
how: Transcript + time map; account for cuts already baked into the source (never reveal stray frames of an adjacent take when returning from B-roll); when shifting a shot boundary keep the absolute timing of spoken words; choose fps from the actual source; do not upscale without reason; long videos get fewer inserts and more reading time; no presenter → no splits or presenter captions. Names, numbers, interfaces and quotes must match the source; ask about an unintelligible phrase rather than inventing it. Presenter splits: a restrained push entry only for horizontal splits with one presenter; the insert keeps its final crop through the slide; the presenter is re-cropped, never squeezed (crop aspect = card aspect).

name_ar: فحص القدرة واختبارات قصيرة قبل التصدير
name_en: Capability preflight and short tests before an expensive export
what: قبل وعد بملف MP4 تأكد من الوصول إلى المصدر وفك الصورة والصوت وأدوات التصدير والخطوط والأقنعة، واصنع اختبارات قصيرة أولًا. — Before promising an MP4 confirm access to the source, picture and audio decode, export tools, fonts and masks, and make short tests first.
when: بداية أي مونتاج على مادة المستخدم — the start of any edit on user footage.
how: If something is missing say exactly what and the smallest way forward; never present HTML, code or a plan as a finished video; work on a copy (an installed skill directory may be read-only). Short tests: light and dark B-roll, B&W, typography, one split, one mask. Keep layers clean (source, inserts, text, masks, sound) and the previous version. Rights: a Pinterest find does not establish usage rights; generation is optional and needs an agreed budget; generated imagery is never presented as historical evidence. Deliver the MP4, an editable project, a dependency list and sources; if music was added, also a version without it. 'Contact sheets and numbers do not replace watching and listening'; never report an unperformed check as passed.

name_ar: القص الدقيق بالإطار يحتاج إعادة ترميز
what: القص بنسخ التدفق دون ترميز يلتصق بالإطارات المفتاحية؛ للقص الدقيق أعد الترميز. — Stream-copy trims snap to keyframes; re-encode for frame-accurate cuts.
when: قص لقطات على ضربات أو كلمات بدقة إطار — cutting shots on beats or words to the frame.
how: Ran here (V8) on a 10 s 30 fps clip with a keyframe every 60 frames, asking for 1.3–3.3 s (60 frames from frame 39): output seeking with -c copy started at the next keyframe (frame 60) → 41 frames, 1.367 s; input seeking with -c copy kept 62 frames / 2.167 s; re-encoding (`ffmpeg -ss 1.3 -to 3.3 -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 …`) gave exactly 60 frames, 2.000 s, starting at frame 39. Use -c copy only for rough, keyframe-aligned trims; use proxies (scale=960:-2, ultrafast, crf 28) for previews.
params: copy: 41 or 62 frames vs requested 60; re-encode: 60

name_en: Footage editing layers and project-state hygiene
what: لا تجعل أداة واحدة تفعل كل شيء: التقاط، ثم بنية بالذكاء (نص، مواضيع، مقاطع ميتة، قائمة قص)، ثم ffmpeg، ثم Remotion، ثم صوت أو صورة مولدة، ثم برنامج مونتاج للتشطيب. — Do not make one tool do everything: capture, then AI structure (transcript, topics, dead sections, edit list), then ffmpeg, then Remotion, then generated audio/visuals, then an editor for finishing.
when: مشروع مونتاج طويل أو متعدد الأدوات — a long or multi-tool edit project.
how: The model's job is structure: transcript, topics, dead sections, the EDL and scaffolded ffmpeg commands. Checkpoint the project before and after editor or audio-workstation changes; an API read-back is not proof it was saved; keep rendered media, the editable project and the approval as separate states; audition generated music for silence.

what: لتقليد مونتاج فيديو أرسله المستخدم: افحص، حلّل، طابق النص العربي، احفظ الصوت، استخدم مادة مرخصة، ارندر فقط بأداة متاحة، افحص، ثم سلّم مع تقرير الفروقات. — To imitate a user's reference edit: inspect, analyse, match the Arabic overlay, keep the audio, use licensed assets, render only with an available executor, QA, and deliver with a discrepancy report.
when: «اعمل مثل هذا الفيديو» أو «نفس المونتاج» — 'make it like this video' or 'the same edit'.
how: 1 inspect (ffprobe; originals read-only; timestamped deterministic frame samples) → 2 analyse (separate scene cuts from camera motion; classify cut/fade/wipe/slide/zoom-blur with measured ranges; keep uncertainty explicit) → 3 Arabic overlay (region geometry, in/out spans, font candidates not identities ARAB-X02, HarfBuzz shaping, mixed script and digits) → 4 audio (original when authorised; no invented word precision) → 5 assets (Pinterest = mood only; licensed media; never copy watermarks) → 6 render only with an exposed executor, else return the plan marked EXECUTOR_NOT_EXPOSED → 7 QA gates (MP4 exists, codec/duration/fps, non-frozen motion, safe zones, Arabic legibility, overlay timing, licence manifest, before/after storyboard; any failure blocks an 'exact match' claim) → 8 deliver MP4 + editable JSON shot plan + storyboard + font-candidate report + discrepancy summary. Not this route: a still image with the same font, Suno lyrics, motion from audio without a reference video, imitating email wording, or only downloading a link.
